title: ManifestDelivery
description: The second ContextManifest event (docs/design/m0/10), appended once per turn as the adapter streams. It evidences that turn: the controller-mediated tool results with the exact handles the core supplied, the adapter's coverage declarations, and compaction marks. Every delivered ref passed the restriction check again before it was supplied (KA1).

handle.description: The handle the core supplied for this result.

ref.description: A declared input of the intent, or a ref derived only from declared inputs: its lineage is non-empty, names only declared inputs, and it keeps every restriction they carry.

declarations.description: What the adapter says it delivered in this turn. Never evidence: each one is declared-only in the finalized coverage.

compacted.description: The harness compacted its context in this turn.
